notes:
Summary: Large EU FS firm; primary ask = private VPC deployment with strict control plane RBAC and full SSO/SCIM lifecycle.

Key requirements (verbally stated by Head of Infra):
- 'We cannot allow Redwood to hold plaintext keys' -> KMS integration mandatory (bring-your-own-key preferred).
- Audit trail to our log bucket (S3 compatible / Azure Blob) with 13 months retention; need schema for events and sample retention config.
- SAML 2.0 IdP (Azure AD) + SCIM v2 provisioning for service accounts and role groups.
- Console RBAC: ability to map AD groups -> Redwood roles; need review of role granularity (admin, infra-ops, app-owners, read-only).
- Network: prefer PrivateLink endpoint into our VPC; fallback option = peering across accounts; NAT/egress constraints noted.

POC scope (agreed rough):
- Deploy private control plane into Veridian test VPC (customer-managed VPC in eu-west-1).
- Integrate Azure Key Vault/AWS KMS as external key provider; demonstrate envelope encryption flow.
- Configure SAML login + automated SCIM sync for 50 service & user accounts; show group->role mapping.
- Export audit logs (auth, admin changes, model deploys, API access) to customer bucket with sample retention policy and log rotation.
- Validate latency SLA: 95th <= 120ms for short chat flows; throughput target 100 req/s during spike.

CRM-style notes / shorthand:
- Infosec checklist: encryption in transit, BYOK, audit schema, SOC2 evidence.
- Legal: review CNDA section 4.2 (crypto key custody).
- Netops: need PrivateLink diagram; point-of-contact = lucas.martin@veridianvaultworks.com
- 'If we can get BYOK + SCIM + RBAC, procurement will push to Prod' (quote from CTO).

Questions outstanding:
- Detailed SCIM attribute list they expect (we sent default mapping, waiting response).
- KMS key rotation integration frequency and KMS audit logs access pattern.
- Whether they require air-gapped private control plane or VPC-connected managed control plane (they prefer VPC for now).

Action items for Redwood team:
- SE Diego to prepare SAML metadata sample and SCIM mapping spreadsheet (due 2026-03-15).
